content.title: Banana Ball Information
content.text: Banana Ball is coming to Prince George’s Stadium! Join us on Friday, July 31 and Saturday, August 1, 2026, as two of Banana Ball’s newest teams - the Indianapolis Clowns and the Loco Beach Coconuts - face off. Please see Frequently Asked Questions below and stay tuned for more information as it becomes available When will Banana Ball be at Prince George’s Stadium? The Chesapeake Baysox are thrilled to announce that the Banana Ball World Tour is coming to the newly renovated Prince George’s Stadium for two nights of high-energy, fan-first entertainment! On Friday, July 31, and Saturday, August 1, 2026, the wildly popular Banana Ball will take the field in Bowie, Maryland, for the first time ever. Fans will enjoy an unforgettable matchup between the Indianapolis Clowns and the Loco Beach Coconuts.Known for their viral videos, electric atmosphere, and rule-breaking style of play, the Savannah Bananas have redefined the game with Banana Ball—a fast-paced, action-packed version of baseball designed to maximize fun and fan engagement. From dancing players and choreographed umpire routines to nonstop crowd interaction, Banana Ball is more than a game—it’s a show. Who are the Loco Beach Coconuts and Indianapolis Clowns? The Loco Beach Coconuts are set to host the Indianapolis Clowns for two thrilling nights of Banana Ball action on Friday, July 31 and Saturday, August 1 at Prince George’s Stadium.These matchups mark a special moment in the Banana Ball Championship League, as the Coconuts and Clowns are the newest additions to the now six-team lineup. Both teams were officially unveiled during the 2026 Banana Ball City Selection Show on Thursday, October 9.The Clowns pay homage to the legendary Negro Leagues team celebrated for their dazzling showmanship and inventive trick plays. As one of the first barnstorming teams to tour the country, their legacy lives on in this exciting new chapter.The Coconuts, meanwhile, draw their name from the laid-back, beach-town spirit of Loco Beach—a fictional coastal paradise created to embody the fun, flair, and unpredictability of Banana Ball.To learn more about the Coconuts, the Clowns, and the wild world of Banana Ball, visit bananaball.com. How can I get tickets? Fans currently have the opportunity to purchase suite, club level, and picnic tickets.For more information on these premium ticket options, sign up here Is there a rain date? Yes, the rain date is Sunday, August 2, 2026. How can I purchase suite, club level, or picnic tickets? To learn more about the event, including suites and other premium seating options. Click here to purchase. What sponsorship opportunities are available? For those interested in sponsorship opportunities with the Baysox, please email our Director of Partnerships, Justin Kelleher Is a parking pass required? Yes, parking passes are required for all vehicles, including those displaying a handicap placard. Parking passes will be available for purchase when tickets go on sale. Your vehicle must fit within a standard-sized parking spot.
